{{Quote|That guy I saw taking off on a speeder bike. He a friend of yours?''"<br />"''He's a sniper. He just shot some people. I took the swoop to go after him.''"<br />"''I got a bone to pick with him, too, so shove over!|Gizz and Nuru Kungurama|<ref name="SM 3" />}}
A '''mission''' was conducted on [[Vaced/Legends|Vaced]] by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Breakout Squad]].

==Prelude==
Following a mission to [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss space]] and an escape from a [[Black hole/Legends|black hole]]<ref name="SM 2" /> in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="ERC" /> the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] group known as [[Breakout Squad]] returned to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. En route, they were contacted by [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] to divert to Vaced and meet [[Commissioner (Kynachi)|Commissioner]] [[Langu Sommilor]] of [[Kynachi]] and escort him to Coruscant. Elsewhere, [[Hudu Shiv]], a [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] sniper, was hired to [[Assassin/Legends|kill]] Sommilor.<ref name="SM 3" />

==The mission==
{{Quote|Nuru Kungurama, I presume?|Sommilor's impostor to Nuru Kungurama, just prior to his assassination|<ref name="SM 3" />}}
Breakout Squad landed on Vaced in their transport the ''[[Hasty Harpy]]'', [[Captain/Legends|captained]] by [[Lalo Gunn]], ahead of Sommilor. They met Sommilor's [[TL-1800 light freighter|transport]], but as soon as he disembarked, he and his two pilots,<ref name="SM 3" /> in actuality [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] impostors,<ref name="SM 4" /> were [[Death/Legends|killed]] by Shiv's [[Poison dart/Legends|poison darts]].<ref name="SM 3" />

The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Nuru Kungurama]] fled after the sniper and stole a [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]] from a gang, which gave chase. Shiv dropped a [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonator]], which killed the gang, bar one&mdash;[[Gizman|Gizz]]. Gizz joined with Kungurama in the pursuit but was knocked out. Shiv and Kungurama fought in [[Shattered Rock]], but Shiv escaped. Breakout Squad pursued in the ''Hasty Harpy'', and engaged in an aerial duel with [[Hudu Shiv's Pursuer-class enforcement ship|Shiv's ''Pursuer''-class enforcement ship]]. The two starships were destroyed, leading to the perceived death of the assassin.<ref name="SM 3" />

==Aftermath==
Lalo Gunn and Breakout Squad parted ways, and the squad gathered the bodies of the Kynachi and took Sommilor's transport, and saved Gizz from the Vaced authorities. They found planted evidence, which led them to liberate [[Bilbringi Depot]].<ref name="SM 3" /> Soon after, Breakout Squad discovered the real captive Sommilor on-board his ship.<ref name="SM 4" />
